name: 26051-shortgen-rtn8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup 10%, bounded at 4096 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: single-turn synthetic text, prompt 256 tokens and output 32 tokens, both exact -- the backend sets max_tokens and ignore_eos.
purpose: A quick-answer support assistant on an 8B model, eight concurrent users sending short prompts for brief replies, one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM at commit f89f599395190e9b272726e87519ccdf4f53ce46 -- no released wheel is this tree, so the
# engine is built from that checkout.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Width and group size are environment-only knobs, pinned in tuned.yaml.
quantization: rtn

# Pinned so they cannot drift: 1024 / 16384 are what the `LLM` class picks on a >=70 GiB non-A100
# card, while other entry points fall through to the lower SchedulerConfig defaults.
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384
